# Patient Room Readiness

> A housekeeping / facilities **room-readiness checklist**, completed by an inspector immediately before a patient room is handed over for occupancy. It confirms **25 concrete room-fixture checkpoints** — bedding and furniture, utilities, bathroom fittings, and the physical fabric of the room (walls, window, ceiling, door) — are present and in acceptable condition.
